title: Turkish-Style Breakfast Tacos
description: A hearty twist on traditional tacos, featuring scrambled eggs, chorizo, and a tangy salsa.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of almond oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chorizo from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of almond oil.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Push the garlic to one side of the skillet.
Crack in 2-3 eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Add the menemen spice blend to the eggs and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the scrambled eggs onto a tortilla, followed by some chorizo, a sprinkle of feta cheese, and a dollop of menemen salsa.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
